author: Yffe
content: RESOLVED against code: forge/src/check.rs VerusOutcome::Counterexample doc + classify_verus_outcome branch (b) confirm the fast-unknown incompleteness edge IS absorbed into Counterexample ('an unknown returned FAST without exhausting the rlimit -> no profile -> the failure path'), and the witness-less fallback emits a generic ObligationResult::failed with NO witnessing input. So the byte-identical Verus engine of increment (i) maps an SMT unknown to Verdict::Refuted -> ladder_action_l3 HardFail, violating REQ-3/AC-3 ('an SMT unknown (incompleteness) is Unknown, never Refuted'; 'Refutation requires ... a witnessing input') from day one. The doc's hedge points to 'REQ-3 + OQ-3' but OQ-3 is the trust-lattice question and says nothing about this; no OQ or decision covers it. Unstated interactions: (1) REQ-5's Proven+Refuted soundness HALT becomes spuriously triggerable (Verus fast-unknown misread as Refuted + Lean kernel proof = false alarm); (2) REQ-9's killed-iff-Refuted counts a fast-unknown mutant as killed (ratio inflation, R-DEFER-9). Correction: REQ-2 must define Verus Refuted = Counterexample WITH a parsed structured witness, error-without-profile-and-without-witness = Unknown (or explicitly record the byte-identical exception as a named pre-existing seam + quarantine it from REQ-5/REQ-9).
